note: AWARE has TWO web trees and only one ships. The repo's www/ is the legacy/dev tree and contains getUserMedia in modules reachable from visible buttons; the PUBLIC build assembles a different bundle that contains none of it. Reading www/ produced a false P0 on 2026-09-06. These expectations are checked against the SHIPPED IPA only.

mustNotContain.why: Release contract section 5 excludes numeric phone-microphone sound-level claims and live microphone-to-speaker simulation. The build enforces this by assembling a bundle without them; this asserts the enforcement actually happened rather than trusting the contract text.

capabilityCoupling.why: Two-way rule. If the shipped bundle can reach the microphone the key must be declared or iOS kills the app; if it cannot, declaring the key over-claims a permission the app never uses and invites App Review questions. The ios-depot workflow asserts this key is ABSENT, and this proves that assertion is correct rather than merely asserted.

Same TCC class that crashed 16 tagged iHEARtest builds (42 through 58), but narrowed. A bare share call is not evidence of a photo-library write: sharing a PDF offers Save to Files and never touches the library, while sharing a PNG offers Save Image and does. AWARE shares PDFs, so requiring the photo-add key on any navigator.share would be a false positive. Both patterns must hit the SAME file, so a thumbnail helper elsewhere in the bundle cannot combine with an unrelated share call to trip it.
